title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde

vibeProfile.oneLine: A good doctor brews a potion to free his darker self, and cannot cage it again.

summary: A respectable London doctor develops a potion that lets him split off and indulge his darker self, the brutal Mr Hyde, and slowly loses control of which man he is. Stevenson's short, taut novella turned a private nightmare into a permanent metaphor for the divided self, the decent citizen and the monster he carries inside. Structured almost like a detective story, it builds to one of literature's most famous revelations, and remains a chillingly modern parable about temptation, respectability and the cost of a double life.
whyReadIt: A perfect, unsettling evening's read that gave us a phrase for the divided self. Short, sharp and still genuinely creepy.

funFacts.text: Stevenson reportedly wrote the first draft in a few days, then burned it and rewrote the whole thing.
